error[L0315]: this argument is passed `inout`, so the call may change its storage while `saved` still views it

  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/variant-match-reference-payload-live-view/main.ldn:16:13

  = note: [0800]/[0830]: the `inout` parameter `value` locks its argument whether or not the routine writes it; finish with `saved` before the call and take it again after, or, if the routine only reads it, declare `value` without `inout`
